claim_text: Pregnancy requires attention to adequate folate intake, but product choice and supplementation should follow current antenatal guidance; methylfolate should not be presented as automatically superior to folic acid for neural-tube-defect prevention.
health_goal_or_outcome: Prevent duplicate supplementation and unsupported wellness claims; support safe total-intake assessment.

population.other_context: Pregnant people considering methylfolate or other folate products.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Dietary and supplemental sources; verify exact product label and formulation.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Folate fact sheet describes folate forms and pregnancy-related guidance.
limitations: Use current local obstetric guidance; no individualized dose from this claim.
Exact source passages and underlying evidence require full appraisal before approval.
